    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    p2 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r1, c1 = p1
    r2, c2 = p2
    dr = (r2 > r1) - (r2 < r1)
    dc = (c2 > c1) - (c2 < c1)

        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3

    r, c = r1, c1
    if abs(r2-r1) >= abs(c2-c1):
        axis_c = c2 + ((c1 > c2) - (c1 < c2))

        end_r = r2 + ((r1 > r2) - (r1 < r2))

        r += dr

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    p1 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    p2 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r1, c1 = p1
    r2, c2 = p2
    dr = (r2 > r1) - (r2 < r1)
    dc = (c2 > c1) - (c2 < c1)

    def mark(r, c):
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3

    r, c = r1, c1
    if abs(r2-r1) >= abs(c2-c1):
        axis_c = c2 + ((c1 > c2) - (c1 < c2))
        while c != axis_c:
            r += dr
            c += dc
            mark(r, c)
        end_r = r2 + ((r1 > r2) - (r1 < r2))
        while r != end_r:
            r += dr
            mark(r, c)
        r += dr
        c += dc
        mark(r, c)
    else:
        axis_r = r2 + ((r1 > r2) - (r1 < r2))
        while r != axis_r:
            r += dr
            c += dc
            mark(r, c)
        end_c = c2 + ((c1 > c2) - (c1 < c2))
        while c != end_c:
            c += dc
            mark(r, c)
        r += dr
        c += dc
        mark(r, c)
    return out
